STORIES.t: 8 grandchildren came to the party. Each child brought 2 gifts. How many gifts did Grandpa get?
Grandpa had 80 treats in total. He put the same number in each of 8 goody bags. How many treats are in each bag?
Michael picked 30 orange flowers and 22 yellow flowers. He shared them equally between his 2 sisters. How many flowers does each sister get?
A spider has 8 legs. How many legs do 3 spiders have?
A beetle has 6 legs. 4 beetles sit on a log. How many legs are there?
Stella found 45 shells. She gave 12 shells to her friend. How many shells does Stella have now?
There were 26 ducks on the pond. Then 17 more ducks landed. How many ducks are on the pond now?
20 seeds are planted in 4 pots. Each pot gets the same number of seeds. How many seeds go in each pot?
A giraffe is 5 meters tall. A zebra is 2 meters tall. How much taller is the giraffe?
5 octopuses swim by. Each octopus has 8 arms. How many arms is that in total?
The class has 24 magnifying glasses. They are shared equally by 6 tables. How many does each table get?
A sea star has 5 arms. How many arms do 6 sea stars have?
Stella read 18 pages about volcanoes on Monday and 25 pages on Tuesday. How many pages did she read in total?
The bird feeder had 50 seeds. The birds ate 35 seeds. How many seeds are left?
A bird has 2 wings. 9 birds sit on a wire. How many wings are there?
A hen laid 12 eggs. She put the same number of eggs in 3 nests. How many eggs are in each nest?
Mia has 34 rocks. Stella has 51 rocks. How many more rocks does Stella have than Mia?
A scientist had 60 test tubes. She broke 7 of them. How many test tubes does she have now?
There are 3 fish tanks. Each tank has 7 fish. How many fish are there altogether?
The zoo has 35 penguins and 28 seals. How many animals is that altogether?

join: Two groups join into one bigger group.
Are two groups put together into one?
take: Some things go away, get used up or are given away.
Does something go away or get used up?
groups: Several groups, and every group has the same number.
Are there groups that each have the same number?
share: A total is split into groups that are all the same size.
Is a total being split into equal parts?
compare: Two amounts side by side. How many more? How much taller?
Are we finding how many more one has than the other?
